newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japanese net foreign bond buyers in November - MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japanese net foreign bond buyers in November - MOF.

text.p: Net purchases of foreign bonds by Japanese investors totalled 1.2058 trillion yen in November after net purchases of 1.6741 trillion yen a month earlier, the Ministry of Finance (MOF) said on Monday.
Bonds include beneficiary certificates but exclude all bills.
Net selling of Japanese stocks by foreign investors amounted to 14.3 billion yen in November compared with net sales of 70.3 billion yen the previous month, the ministry said.
Details of Japanese and foreigners' investments were as follows (in billions of yen):
